name: MADigital Announcement Bar
author: muhammadaamir10

sections.description:
MADigital Announcement Bar lets you add a professional notification bar to the top or bottom of your WordPress site — no coding required.

Features

  • Top or bottom position
  • Custom background, text and button colors
  • Live countdown timer for flash sales
  • Sticky bar — stays visible while scrolling
  • Close button with session memory
  • Slide or fade animation
  • Adjustable height and font size
  • Mobile responsive
  • Lightweight — no page speed impact

Perfect For

  • Sales announcements
  • Event countdowns
  • Cookie consent notices
  • Newsletter signup prompts
  • Free shipping announcements
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via Plugins menu
  3. Go to Announcement Bar in your dashboard
  4. Configure and save
sections.faq:
Does it slow my site down?

No. The plugin is extremely lightweight.

Can visitors close the bar?

Yes. Enable the close button option.

Does the countdown reset?

No. It counts to your set date and stops.
